title: Looking for good Execution Systems Dev
contentFull:
Focus: Trading Infrastructure / Execution Systems
Requirements

熟悉 Rust ，精通 Python
对编译原理、Data Warehouse 有自己的理解

2.Trading Pipeline Tooling 专注交易链路上的工具开发，包括：

data pipeline 、message bus 扩展
risk control tools
execution algo
backtest

3.Framework

了解 Nautilus Trader 框架 https://github.com/nautechsystems/nautilus_trader

Compensation

Base Salary: $5,000 – $10,000 USD / month
Bonus: Project based bonus

Office Location: Hong Kong / Remote
